title: Juniper and the Passage
premise: Salvage diver Ivo Pemberton is hired to strip a wrecked navy freighter off the coast, but the cargo manifests don't match what he finds in the hold. A dying prospector named Juniper Hale trades him a hand-drawn map through the Serrat Range for a promise: deliver it to her daughter before the passes close. Pursued by men who want the map destroyed and shadowed by the truth of what the navy ship was really carrying, Ivo crosses the mountains with Juniper's estranged daughter, Mara, discovering that the map leads not just through the range but to the wreck's missing manifest — and to Ivo's own buried identity as the son of the officer who scuttled her. In the end, Ivo chooses love over duty, burning the official record and giving Mara the truth instead, though the crossing costs him his livelihood and nearly his life.
about_author: Noor Iversen is a former maritime surveyor who spent a decade charting cold-water wrecks along the northern coast before turning to fiction full-time. She writes adventure stories about people caught between what they were paid to do and what they know is right.

chapters.title: Miles, Not Years
chapters.summary: Ivo Pemberton dives the wreck of the navy freighter Vantage, cataloging salvage while noting discrepancies between the official manifest and what actually lies in the flooded hold. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: restless competence masking a man who has stopped expecting anything from life.

chapters.title: The Dying Trade
chapters.summary: In a coastal tavern, prospector Juniper Hale, coughing blood, offers Ivo a hand-drawn map through the Serrat Range in exchange for one promise: carry it to her daughter before the snows. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: reluctant compassion; he accepts without believing he'll keep the promise.

chapters.title: What the Navy Won't Discuss
chapters.summary: Ivo returns to the Vantage to finish the job and finds other divers already there — professionals who warn him off and search his boat. He realizes Juniper knew what the ship carried. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: first real fear; the salvage job has become something else.

chapters.title: Juniper's Last Night
chapters.summary: Ivo sits with Juniper as she dies, and she tells him fragments: the Vantage was scuttled deliberately, and her husband was aboard. She makes him swear again. POV: Ivo, with Juniper's voice threading through. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into obligation.

chapters.title: The Road to Serrat
chapters.summary: Ivo travels inland to find Juniper's daughter, Mara Hale, a range guide who wants nothing to do with her mother's legacy. When strangers ransack Mara's cabin looking for the map, the two flee together. POV: alternating Ivo and Mara. Emotional beat: friction between two guarded strangers bound by a dead woman.

chapters.title: Terms of Passage
chapters.summary: Mara agrees to guide Ivo across only if he tells her everything; he gives her half-truths about the map and none about himself. They buy supplies and learn the passes close within three weeks. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: wary bargain struck out of necessity, not trust.

chapters.title: First Ascent
chapters.summary: The pair enters the foothills, and Mara tests Ivo on the trail, finding him stronger and more capable than a salvage diver should be. The pursuers' camp is spotted below them. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: grudging respect beginning to form.

chapters.title: The River Crossing
chapters.summary: A glacial river swollen by early melt nearly takes Ivo; Mara saves him, and that night he finally admits the map may lead to something worth killing for. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: vulnerability; debt and attraction entangle.

chapters.title: Ashfall Camp
chapters.summary: Trapped by weather, they shelter in an abandoned mining camp where Mara deciphers part of the map and realizes it marks the Vantage's true cargo route overland — her father died guarding it. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: rage at both parents, and the first crack in her armor.

chapters.title: The Men on the Ridge
chapters.summary: The pursuers ambush them at dawn; Ivo's combat instincts surface, startling Mara, and they escape with a wounded pursuer left alive who reveals he works for the shipping consortium, not the navy. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: shame at what he can do; the mask slipping.

chapters.title: What Ivo Buried
chapters.summary: Forced onto the high traverse, Ivo confesses: he is the son of Commander Pemberton, the officer who scuttled the Vantage and vanished. Mara recoils. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: betrayal — the promise she trusted was made to a liar.

chapters.title: Cold Camp
chapters.summary: They travel in silence through worsening cold; Mara considers abandoning him but reads Juniper's letter again and understands her mother chose Ivo deliberately. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: painful recalibration — anger giving way to harder questions.

chapters.title: The Frozen Lake
chapters.summary: Crossing a frozen lake, the ice fails; the map's oilskin case is lost, and Ivo goes under retrieving it, surfacing with hypothermia. Mara drags him to shore. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: near-death strips away pretense; neither can pretend indifference anymore.

chapters.title: The Long Fever
chapters.summary: Ivo fights fever in a cave while Mara keeps him alive and memorizes the water-damaged map by firelight. She finds a second document hidden in its lining: her father's final report naming the consortium's crime. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: love arriving uninvited, tangled with duty to the dead.

chapters.title: Snowbound
chapters.summary: A storm pins them for four days; snowed in, they speak plainly for the first time — about her parents, his father, and what each would sacrifice. The storm breaks early, meaning the far pass may still be open. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: intimacy forged in confinement; hope and dread in equal measure.

chapters.title: The Descent
chapters.summary: They descend toward the valley town where the consortium's agent waits, having tracked them since the ridge. Mara proposes a plan: give the agent a false copy and deliver the real evidence to the provincial magistrate. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: from fugitives to strategists; agency reclaimed.

chapters.title: The Town Called Passage
chapters.summary: In the last town before the pass, the handoff goes wrong — the agent recognizes Ivo and reveals that his father didn't vanish; he testified, then disappeared into consortium custody, possibly still alive. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: the ground shifts; duty to his father collides with the promise to Juniper.

chapters.title: Split Trail
chapters.summary: Ivo wants to go after his father; Mara argues the evidence must reach the magistrate before the pass closes or everyone died for nothing. They separate at the crossroads. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: love against duty made literal; each choosing alone.

chapters.title: The Consulate Records Office
chapters.summary: Ivo infiltrates the consortium's local office searching for his father and finds instead proof his father is dead — killed years ago after testifying, his name on the same report Mara carries. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: grief closing one door; the other choice now clear.

chapters.title: The Magistrate's Door
chapters.summary: Mara reaches the magistrate as the pursuers close in; Ivo arrives at the last moment, drawing them off so she can deliver the report. The agent is arrested; the pass officially closes behind them. POV: Mara, then Ivo. Emotional beat: climax — the promise kept at the edge of ruin.

chapters.title: After the Snows
chapters.summary: Weeks later, the scandal breaks publicly; the Vantage's crew are posthumously honored, Juniper's name among them. Ivo and Mara return to the coast together, no longer running. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: quiet reckoning; survival's price counted and found payable.

chapters.title: The New Chart
chapters.summary: Ivo dives the Vantage one final time, not for salvage but to lay a marker for the dead, then surfaces to Mara waiting in the boat. He measures life differently now. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: resolution — identity remade, love chosen over every duty that came before.
